question.text: In case of multiple nominees, securities are distributed:

answer.text: As per the percentage specified by the account holder at an ISIN level
Equally among all nominees regardless of the holder's instructions
Based on the nominees' ages (eldest first)

explanation.text: The Logic: In case of multiple nominees, the participant distributes securities as per the percentage specified by the account holder at an ISIN level. If no percentage is specified, the allocation is equal. Any indivisible residual securities go to the first-named nominee. The Trap: Defaulting to equal distribution ignores the holder's specified percentages and applies only when no percentage is given. Note: The Series VI workbook (pp.119-121) is the controlling source: distribution follows percentages at the ISIN level; equal allocation applies when percentages are not provided; indivisible residual securities go to the first-named nominee.
